mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_posts(id, owner_id, type, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.ownerId}, #{row.type}, #{row.status}, #{row.version}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt})

INSERT INTO community_post_drafts(post_id, owner_id, type, business_date, title, summary, body_markdown, source_selection, saved_at) VALUES (#{row.postId}, #{row.ownerId}, #{row.type}, #{row.businessDate}, #{row.title}, #{row.summary}, #{row.bodyMarkdown}, CAST(#{row.sourceSelection} AS JSONB), #{row.savedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM community_posts WHERE id=#{postId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId}
SELECT * FROM community_posts WHERE id=#{postId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM community_posts WHERE id=#{postId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM community_post_drafts WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId}
SELECT * FROM community_post_revisions WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND id=#{revisionId}
SELECT * FROM community_post_revisions WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(revision_no),0)+1 FROM community_post_revisions WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId}
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id,p.owner_id,r.type,r.business_date,r.title,r.summary,r.body_markdown,p.first_published_at, r.published_at,r.id AS revision_id,r.revision_no, COALESCE(profile.nickname,'未设置昵称') AS nickname,COALESCE(profile.bio,'') AS bio FROM community_posts p JOIN community_post_revisions r ON r.id=p.current_revision_id AND r.post_id=p.id AND r.owner_id=p.owner_id LEFT JOIN community_public_profiles profile ON profile.owner_id=p.owner_id WHERE p.status='PUBLISHED'
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS post_id,p.type,p.status,p.version,d.business_date,d.title,d.summary,p.updated_at, p.first_published_at,p.current_revision_id,r.revision_no AS current_revision_no, (r.id IS NULL OR ROW(d.business_date,d.title,d.summary,d.body_markdown) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(r.business_date,r.title,r.summary,r.body_markdown) OR ARRAY(SELECT attachment_id FROM community_draft_attachments WHERE post_id=p.id AND owner_id=p.owner_id ORDER BY position) IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY(SELECT attachment_id FROM community_revision_attachments WHERE revision_id=r.id AND post_id=p.id AND owner_id=p.owner_id ORDER BY position)) AS has_unpublished_changes, moderation.reason AS moderation_reason,moderation.occurred_at AS moderated_at FROM community_posts p JOIN community_post_drafts d ON d.post_id=p.id AND d.owner_id=p.owner_id LEFT JOIN community_post_revisions r ON r.id=p.current_revision_id AND r.post_id=p.id AND r.owner_id=p.owner_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT reason,occurred_at FROM community_moderation_audit WHERE post_id=p.id AND owner_id=p.owner_id ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) moderation ON TRUE WHERE p.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND p.status=#{status} AND p.type=#{type} ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC,p.id DESC
SELECT reason,occurred_at FROM community_moderation_audit WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
